_note: SAMPLE — this is the committed fallback file so a fresh clone renders; it is NOT a desk run and NOT a state snapshot. Every brokerage section (account, positions, candidates, orders, backtests) is EMPTY on purpose and every on-chain figure is null, so nothing here is simulated or faked. The only real data in this file is the deployed contract addresses on Robinhood Chain mainnet (chainId 4663): the dashboard reads those contracts live and populates the on-chain band from that read alone — if the read fails, the band stays empty instead of showing a number. Mainnet · no third-party audit · deposits capped at 10,000 USDG · no deposits and no trades yet, so there is no track record. A real desk run (or a connected account via the backend) fills the rest.

onchain._contractsNote: Real Robinhood Chain mainnet (4663) deployment — mirrors onchain/deployments/latest.json. Ownership handover is COMPLETE: every owner-controlled contract in the stack is owned by the 2-of-3 Safe 0x47b5e2923216f203b7960d8D232215534AF02FF2, so changing any risk cap, feed, deposit cap or session grant requires 2 of 3 signatures. The Safe called acceptOwnership() on RWAVault, ChainlinkOracleAdapter and SessionKeyExecutor in one batch (tx 0x1ee7a73e7c3df216579554cd3d5993dfeee6be2bd081a68f59700efbd5968cea); all three now return the Safe from owner() and the zero address from pendingOwner(), so nothing is half-transferred, and the deployer EOA now reverts with OwnableUnauthorizedAccount on owner-only calls. GuardrailConfig and UniswapSwapAdapter were Safe-owned from construction and never passed through the deployer at all. That is custody only: the code still has NO third-party audit, and contracts are not yet verified on the block explorer.
onchain._guardrailsNote: Intentionally empty: guardrails are rendered as 'enforced on-chain' and must come ONLY from a live GuardrailConfig read — never from this sample. They populate for real from Robinhood Chain mainnet.
onchain._trackRecordNote: Intentionally all-null: there is no track record. No deposits, no trades, no attestations — never seed a number here.
onchain._executorNote: SessionKeyExecutor is deployed on mainnet 4663 and owned by the 2-of-3 Safe (handover accepted, pendingOwner cleared), so granting or revoking a session key takes 2 of 3 signatures. No session key has been granted and no trade has been executed — hence status 'preview', not 'live'.
